verdict.rationale: Trigger.dev doesn't document explicit data-retention settings or deletion APIs for run/task data, but self-hosting is offered, giving users full control over their infrastructure and thus over how long data is retained or when it's deleted. This is an indirect, infrastructure-level workaround rather than a first-class retention/deletion control feature in the product itself. Missing for 10: explicit retention policy documentation, configurable log/run TTLs, GDPR-style data-deletion API or dashboard control on the managed cloud offering.
